Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: This is a specialized HDX-MS experiment. The primary goal is to compare the deuterium uptake (site-level kinetics) between the apo (ligand-free) and holo (mRNA-bound) states of the MDMX-S403D protein. Standard bottom-up pipelines will not suffice as the analysis requires calculating RFU and comparing exchange rates across time points (10s, 120s, 1800s).
